root.label: Node handles and heterogeneous lookup
root.note: Splice nodes between containers and search without building keys.

children.label: Node handles (C++17)
children.note: Move-only owners of one detached node.

children.label: extract
children.note: Unlinks a node by iterator or key with no allocation; a missing key gives an empty handle.

children.label: Edit the key
children.note: nh.key() is mutable, the only way to rename a map key without copying.

children.label: Move out of a set
children.note: nh.value() is mutable, so an element can be moved out of a set.

children.label: Reference validity
children.note: References to an extracted element are unusable while owned, valid again after insertion.

children.label: Inserting nodes
children.note: Reinsertion is a relink, not a copy.

children.label: insert_return_type
children.note: Holds position, inserted and node; the node keeps the element after a duplicate failure.

children.label: Empty handle insert
children.note: No effect: inserted is false, position is end(), node is empty.

children.label: Multi containers
children.note: Insertion cannot fail on duplicates and returns a plain iterator.

children.label: merge
children.note: Splice every non-conflicting node from another container.

children.label: Duplicates stay behind
children.note: Elements whose key exists in the destination remain in the source.

children.label: Compatible containers
children.note: Comparator or hash may differ, and map and multimap interchange.

children.label: Allocator rules
children.note: The node carries its container's allocator.

children.label: Equal allocators needed
children.note: insert and merge across unequal allocators are undefined.

children.label: pmr resources differ
children.note: Two pmr maps on different resources have unequal allocators.

children.label: Heterogeneous lookup
children.note: Search with a type other than the key.

children.label: Transparent comparator
children.note: std::less<> or any comparator with is_transparent enables template find overloads.

children.label: Unordered (C++20)
children.note: Needs a transparent hash and equality, and hashes must agree across types.

children.label: Erase and extract (C++23)
children.note: Template overloads take transparent keys; excluded for iterator-convertible types.

children.label: Insertion forms (C++26)
children.note: operator[], at, try_emplace and insert_or_assign gain heterogeneous overloads.

children.label: Pitfalls
children.note: Transparency is a promise the container trusts.

children.label: Both argument orders
children.note: The comparator must accept key-versus-other and other-versus-key.

children.label: Consistent ordering
children.note: Foreign comparisons must agree with key ordering, or lookup is undefined.

children.label: Library support
children.note: g++-16 has C++23 erase and extract; libc++ 21 lacks them.
